system.description:
Lifesense allows a creature to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures as a tertiary sense. The sense can distinguish between the positive energy animating living creatures and the negative energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colours.

Life Sense (Pillars of Faith, Chapter 9). A tertiary sense at full range, as Graham ruled for the Codex's own Life Sense (11 Aug 2026): it finds living and undead creatures and tells the two apart.

sense.name: Life Sense
sense.finds: living and undead creatures (and tells them apart)
